agent_explanation: Two massive bodies undergo a close encounter (distance ~0.87 at step 13 -> 0.72 at step 14 -> 0.65 at step 15) with high speeds ~8. Substeps per step only rise to 11-12, insufficient to resolve the steeply rising softened gravity, so leapfrog integration loses energy progressively (179.06 at step 13, 173.15 at step 14, 160.93 at step 15). Reducing dt to 0.001 with identical initial conditions removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
